description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the MembershipDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods to verify the functionality of membership-related database operations such as add, edit, retrieve, delete, and check existence of membership records.

classes.name: MembershipDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing MembershipDao database operations related to membership management in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of MembershipDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testAddMembership
methods.description: Tests the ability to add a new membership record and verify its persistence.

methods.name: testEditMembership
methods.description: Tests updating an existing membership record and verifies the changes.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of memberships based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific membership by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteMemberships
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple membership records by IDs and verifies the deletion count.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests attempting to delete a non-existing membership record and expects zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Tests checking the existence of membership names with case insensitivity and whitespace handling.
